newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Tallinn Pharma active again on Estonia bourse.
newsitem.headline: Tallinn Pharma active again on Estonia bourse.

text.p: Shares in drugs firm Tallinn Pharmaceutical were active again on the Estonian stock market on Thursday, trading some six million kroons on the second-tier free market list, dealers said.
The company yesterday registered 13 million kroons of business as a big block of shares changed hands.
"The block trade on Wednesday kept interest in Pharmaceutical high," said Tallinnapank dealer Toomas Tsopp.
The main stock market list showed volume of 7.7 million kroons and the index rose 0.21 percent to 96.85. The free market saw trade of 8.6 million kroons.
Shares in Hansapank were the most traded on the official list at 4.4 million kroons and it rose to 96.15 kroons from yesterday's 95.50 kroons.
Union Bank registered trade of 1.5 million kroons and its shares also rose, hitting 20.95 kroons after 20.85 kroons.
Saku Brewery, traded on the free market and whose first-half results are due tomorrow, turned over 1.1 million kroons and it rose to 34.50 kroons from 34.17 kroons.
